lessons_used: Predictions were generally overoptimistic for non-winning tests, but underpredicted gains for the winning tests.
sign_in hint and home wait_info were helpful changes, as both won their tests.
choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change types as each has only been tested once.

candidates.title: Desktop Hatching Progress Stage Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a split stage layout displaying a real-time pet hatching progress visualization and system readiness checklist.
candidates.why: Home step median time is 201s (mean 2336s) and support received bug reports about desktop pets not displaying; a split stage clear visualization keeps users informed.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen layout while keeping its core job and real-time wait visual is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Redesigning home screen showed 0.0% lift previously; high implementation cost for zero expected gain.

candidates.title: Desktop Presence Verification Screen
candidates.change: Add a new desktop presence check screen right after waiting to verify pet display and tray icon visibility before the home intro screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported the pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open upon setup completion; adding a dedicated verification screen catches display issues early.

new_desktop_check.headline: Checking Desktop Visibility
new_desktop_check.body: Ensuring your new pet appears on your desktop screen and system tray.

guard.reason: Adding a new verification screen inside onboarding prior to home_intro is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen increases onboarding friction; finish step changes previously resulted in negative lift.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Adoption Naming Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Transform the adoption certificate step into an interactive sub-flow with live pet naming input and certificate customization.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%); an interactive custom naming flow deepens emotional attachment and completion rates.

adoption_certificate.headline: Name Your New Desktop Companion
adoption_certificate.body: Give your pet an official name to complete the adoption certificate.

guard.reason: Adding an interactive pet naming sub-flow to the adoption certificate step is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Targeting lowest conversion step (60.9%) has high potential, but full sub-flow requires high build effort.

candidates.title: Path First Onboarding Sequence
candidates.change: Reorder onboarding so path selection happens immediately upon launch before reading the full story scroll.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s; placing path choice first lets users make their core decision upfront before story context.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Account Recovery Pet Sync Safety Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint to the sign-in screen informing users that signing into their account automatically restores all previously owned pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again; sign_in hints were proven successful in prior tests.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically syncs and restores your existing pets and collection data safely.

guard.reason: Adding copy clarifying account sync on the sign-in screen is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints previously won with +3.1% lift, strongly backed by 8 support tickets and low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Time and Progress Wait Status
candidates.change: Enable detailed progress status, step counter, and time estimate countdown on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a 201s median / 2336s mean time; previous wait_info additions won their tests by reducing uncertainty.

waiting.hint: Your desktop pet is being configured. This usually takes under 2 minutes.

guard.reason: Adding real wait progress and step details to the waiting screen is allowed under Rules 4 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info directly won prior tests (+3.9%) by addressing long wait times (201s median) at low cost.

candidates.title: Adoption Companion Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Display a special adoption milestone badge on the friend selection screen highlighting extra starter pet animations.
candidates.why: Adoption drops off to 60.9%; adding an upfront visual milestone badge incentive boosts motivation to complete pet adoption.

guard.reason: Promoting bonus desktop animations violates Rule 3, which prohibits onboarding copy from mentioning free extras, gifts, or bonuses.

candidates.title: Focused Spotlight Path Layout
candidates.change: Change the path selection screen layout to spotlight, highlighting one path card prominently at a time.
candidates.why: choose_path mean time of 514s suggests decision paralysis; spotlight layout reduces visual noise and speeds up path selection.

guard.reason: Updating the choose path layout design inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesigns and copy changes consistently failed to show positive lift in previous tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Quick Controls Banner
candidates.change: Add a highlighted notification banner on the final intro screen showing desktop tray and click interaction shortcuts.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

components.text: Tip: Right-click your desktop pet or system tray icon anytime to open controls or hide your pet.

guard.reason: Adding user tips to the home intro overlay screen is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Low cost notification banner addresses post-onboarding support issues with mild expected positive lift.

candidates.title: Existing Account Recovery Copy Clarification
candidates.change: Update sign-in screen headline and body copy to explicitly instruct returning users to sign in to retrieve their pets.
candidates.why: Addresses 8 support tickets where users created duplicate accounts or thought pets were deleted upon re-login.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Your Desktop Pets
sign_in.body: Log into your registered account to access existing pets or continue setup.

guard.reason: Clarifying sign-in copy for returning users is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets 8 support tickets with config copy change, though copy changes historically show modest impact.

picked: Account Recovery Pet Sync Safety Hint

decisions.title: Account Recovery Pet Sync Safety Hint

lessons_next: Predictions were generally overoptimistic for non-winning tests, but underpredicted gains for winning tests.
sign_in hint, home wait_info, and adoption new_flow were helpful changes as each won a test.
choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change types as each has only been tested once.
